formal_scope.safety_assumptions: Two startup reset samples; arbitrary later reset. Legal static 64..4096 per-qid quanta. Abstract P03 merged count transitions (0..2), immutable pre-state heads until pop, legal selected packet length 1..MAX. Completion only while TX owns; readiness/completion have no progress bound.
formal_scope.progress_assumptions: Two startup reset samples, arbitrary later resets. Two continuously backlogged 128-byte queues after legal initial publications; q0 quantum64, q1 quantum128; distinct alternating descriptor IDs. TX ready always high; accepted packets retire within20 clocks, only while event-owned. These progress assumptions are absent from safety tasks.
